method: Publish every exact named body in the current official parish roster, the three first-party monastery profiles, and additional exact bodies identified by current first-party pages. Hold aggregate-only, ambiguous, and map-only leads rather than infer them.

candidates.reason: The official site describes additional dependent chapels and other subordinate bodies without presenting one complete exact named roster. No body is inferred from an aggregate or a general reference.
The parish roster mixes institutional landlines with clergy mobile numbers. Mobile-only values and values explicitly marked as mobile are excluded from body contact fields.
Search and map results remain unpublished unless a competent first-party Church source establishes the exact body and its current canonical parent.

source_reconciliations.subject: Current official parish roster
source_reconciliations.decision: The official roster names 40 exact churches across four archieratical regions. All 40 are published once with their displayed seats, dedications, and institutional landlines where present.

source_reconciliations.subject: Monasteries and additional exact bodies
source_reconciliations.decision: Three monastery profiles add three exact monasteries. Current official pages add two pilgrimage bodies, a newly consecrated church in Galipsos, a Saint Mary Magdalene chapel in Domatia, and two exact Prophet Elijah bodies. Each body is published once and no aggregate gap is manufactured.

source_reconciliations.subject: Body contact boundary
source_reconciliations.decision: Twenty-seven roster bodies carry fixed institutional landlines and the three monastery profiles carry monastery telephone numbers. Clergy mobile numbers are excluded. Parent-level site details are not copied into body-owned site fields, and no unsupported email address is added.

source_reconciliations.subject: Cathedral ranks
source_reconciliations.decision: Saint Nicholas is published as the Metropolitan Cathedral from its dedicated first-party page. Saint Eleutherius is published as a cathedral using the official metropolitan publication. The remaining roster bodies retain the parish rank unless another first-party page establishes a more specific rank.

official_parent_audit.result: 49 exact named bodies published: 40 roster churches, three monasteries, two pilgrimage bodies, and four additional current exact churches or chapels.
official_parent_audit.roster_status: complete displayed exact roster plus current exact first-party supplements

exclusions.decision: No chapel, cemetery church, monastic dependency, or other body is inferred solely from an aggregate or a general statement.
Clergy mobile numbers are excluded. Only fixed institutional landlines and monastery contact numbers tied to exact bodies are published.
Search and map leads remain in discovery until a competent first-party Church source establishes identity and canonical parentage.
